_metadata.source: Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI), CFTRI Mysore, and KVIC Project Profiles
_metadata.validation_status: Benchmark processing yields, recovery rates, and cost profiles for farm and MSME scale value-addition

turmeric.processing_method: Wash harvested rhizomes with water to remove adhering soil, grade into mother and finger rhizomes, air-dry surface moisture.
turmeric.equipment_required: Water wash tank, sorting mesh table
turmeric.limitations: Highly perishable; must be sold within 7-10 days of harvest to avoid shrinkage and weight loss.

turmeric.processing_method: Boil fresh rhizomes in perforated steam boiler for 45-60 min. Sun-dry on clean tarpaulins for 10-12 days until moisture drops to 9%. Mechanical polish in polishing drum.
turmeric.equipment_required: Perforated boiling vat / boiler, drying tarpaulins, mechanical polishing drum
turmeric.limitations: Requires adequate sunshine and drying yard space; sudden unseasonal rains during sun-drying can cause fungus.

turmeric.processing_method: Micro-pulverize dry polished turmeric fingers using stainless steel hammer mill or pin mill to 80-100 mesh. Sieve, blend for uniform color, and nitrogen-flush pack in food-grade foil pouches.
turmeric.equipment_required: Stainless steel pulverizer (5 HP), vibrating sifter, semi-automatic pouch sealing machine
turmeric.licenses_required: FSSAI State License, Agmark certification, GST registration, Trademark
turmeric.limitations: Requires commercial food safety testing (heavy metals, curcumin percentage, lead chromate adulteration tests) for retail placement.

coconut.processing_method: Manual or mechanical dehusking using iron spike or tractor-PTO powered dehusker. Grade by nut weight (> 500g, 400-500g, < 400g).
coconut.limitations: Susceptible to volatile copra mandi market pricing.

coconut.processing_method: Extract coconut milk from fresh kernel using hydraulic screw press. Centrifuge or naturally ferment milk to separate pure water-clear virgin coconut oil without chemical or heat treatment.
coconut.equipment_required: Coconut deshelling machine, kernel washing unit, milk expeller, high-speed centrifuge / fermentation tank, micro-filtration unit
coconut.licenses_required: FSSAI State License, Coconut Development Board (CDB) Registration, GST
coconut.limitations: Higher initial machinery investment (approx. INR 8 - 15 Lakhs for commercial setup); premium marketing channel required.

coconut.processing_method: Split nuts in half, sun-dry or hot-air dry in copra kiln to 6% moisture. Extract oil using rotary gani or oil expeller (yielding ~62% oil from copra).
coconut.equipment_required: Copra dryer / sun yard, oil expeller / gani
coconut.limitations: Oil cake is a secondary byproduct (feed meal) with modest margins.

banana.processing_method: De-hand bunches into clean hands, wash in alum water bath, drain, pack in corrugated boxes.
banana.equipment_required: De-handing curved knives, washing vat, drying table
banana.limitations: High post-harvest perishability; bunch bruising causes rapid price depreciation.

banana.processing_method: Peel raw green Nendran or Robusta bananas, slice into 1.5mm rounds directly into hot pure coconut oil / refined oil, season with rock salt and black pepper, nitrogen pack.
banana.equipment_required: Rotary vegetable slicer, batch fryer with digital temperature control, oil de-oiler centrifuge, nitrogen band sealer
banana.limitations: Oil absorption and rancidity management require airtight foil packaging.

banana.processing_method: Peel unripened green bananas, slice, blanch in citric acid solution (0.1%), dehydrate in hot-air cabinet dryer at 55°C, micro-mill into gluten-free prebiotic flour.
banana.equipment_required: Cabinet tray dryer, stainless steel pin mill, air classifier
banana.licenses_required: FSSAI State License, Nutrition Lab Test Certification
banana.limitations: Emerging superfood category; requires urban wellness / e-commerce marketing.

black-pepper.processing_method: Thresh harvested spikes, blanch green berries in hot water (80°C) for 1 minute, sun-dry on polythene sheets for 7 days until moisture is 10%, clean through spiral separator.
black-pepper.equipment_required: Spike thresher, blanching vessel, drying yard, winnowing fan
black-pepper.limitations: Long storage without moisture control can cause mold and loss of piperine content.

black-pepper.processing_method: Clean and destone dry black pepper, cryo-grind or water-cooled mill to retain essential volatile oils (piperine & terpenes), pack in glass grinder bottles or composite tins.
black-pepper.equipment_required: Destoner, cold-milling pulverizer, automatic bottle filling and capping machine
black-pepper.licenses_required: FSSAI State License, Agmark Grade Certification, Legal Metrology Registration
black-pepper.limitations: Grinding generates heat which can dissipate aroma if regular high-speed mills are used.

groundnut.processing_method: Clean harvested dried pods using air blower / aspirator to remove dirt, soil, and empty shells.
groundnut.equipment_required: Pedal-operated or electric pod cleaner / grader
groundnut.limitations: Price fluctuations dictated by commodity oil mill procurement seasons.

groundnut.processing_method: Decorticate pods into kernels (~70% kernel recovery). Crush kernels in traditional wooden expeller (Vaagai wood Mara Chekku) at low temperature (< 45°C). Filter oil through cotton cloth filter.
groundnut.equipment_required: Groundnut decorticator, wooden cold press (Mara Chekku), gravity settling tanks
groundnut.licenses_required: FSSAI Registration, GST, Weights & Measures Verification
groundnut.limitations: Residual oil cake (~38 kg) sold as livestock feed at INR 32/kg.
